mutant.original: (buf: Buffer, e: El) => buf.toString('hex', e.data, Math.min(e.end, e.data + 64))
mutant.lineText: const hex = (buf: Buffer, e: El) => buf.toString('hex', e.data, Math.min(e.end, e.data + 64));
mutant.prevText: const str = (buf: Buffer, e: El, max = 4096): string => buf.toString('utf8', e.data, Math.min(e.end, e.data + max)).replace(/\u0000+$/g, '').replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f]/g, '');
